summary: Admin Health Statistics Dashboard (P2) Testing Complete - Backend: 19/19 tests passed (100%), Frontend Admin Panel: All health stats features verified including summary cards, distribution charts, and Videos tab regression
critical_code_review_comments: Backend GET /api/admin/health-stats correctly returns aggregated data from 39 health profiles
All distribution arrays (gender, age, diet, activity, complaints, conditions, deficiencies, medications, bmi) are present and correctly formatted
Sleep averages (avg_quality: 5.6/10, avg_duration: 6.4h) and stress averages (avg_stress: 6.8/10, avg_energy: 4.9/10) are correctly calculated
Complaints include avg_intensity field for each complaint type
Admin panel 'Gesundheit' tab correctly displays all summary cards and horizontal bar charts
Label mappings in app.js correctly translate internal values to German display names
Videos tab correctly shows videos table with DE/IT language toggle and category filter
All admin panel tabs including Videos have proper structure after HTML restructuring
seed_data_creation: Using existing 39 health profiles in MongoDB
context_for_next_testing_agent: ADMIN HEALTH STATS DASHBOARD (P2) COMPLETE AND WORKING. Backend endpoint: GET /api/admin/health-stats returns aggregated anonymized health data. Admin panel at /api/admin-app has 'Gesundheit' tab (last tab in tab bar) showing: 1) Summary cards (Profile gesamt, Schlafqualität Ø, Schlafdauer Ø, Stresslevel Ø, Energielevel Ø), 2) Distribution bar charts for gender, age, diet, activity, BMI, complaints with intensity, deficiencies, conditions, medications. Videos tab regression: Working correctly with DE/IT toggle, shows 1 Italian video when in IT mode.
